node.title: Conditional exact-list first-match assembly with typed Q/MT and SP columns
node.statement: CONDITIONAL EXACT-LIST ASSEMBLY. At every official x4 row and transported quotient row, fix one support-wise first-match priority map on each full locator-prefix fiber. Partition actual list supports into already-paid background classes, explicit quotient/dihedral staircases, the structured moment-null/U2 pullback column, and the remaining primitive star-PTE column. The paid theorem inputs bound their declared classes; u2c_exact_slice_extras_budget bounds the structured column by n^3 after expansion and coalescing; x4_primitive_star_u1_coverage injects every non-base primitive list member into the record population bounded strictly below 16n^3 by u1_x4_direct_column_budget, hence the primitive list column is at most 16n^3; and x4_exactlist_summed_budget proves the one list-side integer sum is at most B*=floor(|F|/2^128). Under those hypotheses every exact list is at most B*. The quotient/dihedral and moment-trade counterexamples explain why the priority columns are necessary. QA.22's MCA slope arithmetic is evidence only and is not used as an unproved per-word list conversion.
node.attack_surface: close the typed structured-column population, primitive-star coverage, and list-side summed-budget leaves separately; preserve one support-wise priority map across them
node.falsifier: a support omitted or multiply owned by the priority map, a primitive star record outside the u1 ledger, or a consumed row whose complete list-side sum exceeds B*
node.notes: Historical quotient, dihedral, and moment-trade counterexamples remain valid and force explicit columns. | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 3): TARGET -> CONDITIONAL. | FULL-LANE COMPRESSION 2026-07-05: the dli lane is recorded in REDUCTION_PACKET.md. | OWNERSHIP REPAIR 2026-08-06: u2c owns the structured moment/null pullback list column; the primitive full-prefix residue requires a separate general-star-to-u1 coverage theorem; and the final sum is list currency, not QA.22 MCA slope currency. Two explicit target leaves now carry those missing obligations.
